format: Blender 5.3 source project (build/foc-t2.blend). MSFS / glTF export is deliberately deferred to r7 (user instruction: finish the modelling in Blender first).

axes.blender_source: X east, Y north, Z up
axes.gltf_target: X east, Y up, Z south (north faces -Z) - applied only at export time in r7

origin.note: local ENU origin = ZSFZ aerodrome reference point; place model at this lat/lon in MSFS

bbox_model_m.note: all objects except the flat terrain base plane

ground_base.note: continuous terrain/ground quad so no void shows around the airport; 0.35 m below the z=0 pavement so it cannot z-fight with it

roof.type: constant-thickness curved plate (distance-field heightfield + downward offset + eave rim)
roof.flat_faces_note: all 1188 flat faces are the vertical eave rim; every surface face is smooth shaded
roof.field: z = TOP_EAVE + (R(p)*g(u) + tip_up(p)*g(u)), u = d/D(p); d = distance to the eave outline, D = measured half width of the volume (hall 72.24 m / pier arms 81.24 m), g = smoothstep with a 12 m flat soffit band at the eave

terminal_massing.junction: glass head 26.25 m sits 0.30 m inside the roof plate (25.95-27.35 m) = designed hidden overlap, not a gap

contents.runways: GEO-RWY-0/1 (75 m paved width = 45 m runway + 15 m shoulders)
contents.taxiways: GEO-TWY-0/1 (23 m wide ribbons, OSM centre lines)
contents.aprons: GEO-APRON-0..5 (OSM apron polygons + 115 m T2 stand apron)
contents.markings: MK-TWY-CL-000..063 (0.45 m yellow centre lines, z=0.20)
contents.ground: GEO-GROUND-BASE (terrain quad) + GEO-GROUND-* (empty: OSM base ring has zero area)

audit_mesh.note: roof volume / plan area = 1.4000 m = the plate thickness, i.e. it really is a uniform thin plate

sources: CAAC AIP ZSFZ aircraft parking chart 2P-1 (AIRAC AMDT 11/26, EFF 2026-10-28) - T2 footprint, runway/taxiway layout, scale
OpenStreetMap via Overpass API (2026-07-28 snapshot) - taxiway centre lines, apron polygons, runway axes (ODbL)
OurAirports runways.csv - ZSFZ runway ends, lengths 3600 m, widths 45 m
Public reports - T2 GFA ~255,000 m2, height 39.7 m, opened 2026-09-16; RWY04/22 named by CAAC though roughly parallel to 03/21
limitations: Roof form is a reconstruction: the crown/section follows the reference photo (thin curved plate) and the AIP footprint, but the exact arch profile of the real building is not published.

PV skylight band is NOT in r6. It was a flat quad in r5 (it sat inside the old thick roof, i.e. invisible); on the new curved surface it has to be re-authored as a patch that follows the relaxed height field.
No eave lattice/louvre panels, no facade mullions, no jet bridges, no landside canopy, no roof-top equipment.
Apron/taxiway coverage comes from OSM and has gaps, so the terrain quad shows between pavement islands; needs filling before the MSFS export.
T1 terminal, cargo, GTC, control tower, stand markings and lighting are not included (out of scope).
Taxiway widths are uniform 23 m; runway 04/22 is drawn parallel to 03/21; THR04 displaced 200 m is not modelled.
Ground is flat (z=0 pavement, -0.35 m terrain quad); ARP elevation 14.0 m is NOT applied - MSFS must offset the model.
No LODs, no collision mesh, no PBR textures (flat colour materials).
version_notes: r1: first massing + pavement, GLB exported.
r4: single lofted saddle roof per part, closed by a flat bottom cap -> 14 m thick wedge in section.
r5: thin-plate attempt (1.4 m, inset rings) rejected by audit_mesh (18-23 self-intersections at the concave eaves), reverted to the r4 shells; r5 GLB archived in out/archive/.

r6: roof rebuilt as a distance-field height field, offset straight down by 1.40 m and closed by an eave rim. audit_mesh pass (0 boundary / 0 nonmanifold / 0 degenerate / 0 self-intersections, single outward shell). Glass recessed 3 m, roof cantilever 8 m, continuous terrain quad added, PV band deferred. MSFS export deferred to r7.
